assumptions.assumption: The CMS runs within the hosted network because the web server that runs it is stated to be on that network.
assumptions.basis: The source says, "The web server runs the CMS" and places the web server on "the same hosted network" as the database.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database is confidential because it contains account information.

assumptions.assumption: The web server is internet-facing because readers hit the public site through it.
assumptions.basis: The source calls it the "Public site" and states that "readers hit the web server over HTTPS".

assumptions.assumption: The CDN is internet-facing because readers fetch content from it.
assumptions.basis: The source states that "Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP."
